title: Sahsah realtime v1 contract
description: Framing plus strict schemas; direction/auth/phase/epoch/role checks remain mandatory.

Revision.description: Canonical unsigned decimal, runtime <=9223372036854775807. Exact bigint transport.

Score.description: Exact nonnegative team total; manual input ceiling is separate from subsequent legal awards.

Time.description: UTC RFC3339 instant ending in Z.

Secret.description: Canonical unpadded base64url of exactly 32 CSPRNG bytes. Client saves before sending; server stores domain-separated hash only.

players.description: Players seated on this team, in seat order. Live views list current players; results list everyone who played.

Selections.description: Distinct position/category; repeat basis only for explicitly accepted actual pack/roster. Start requires exactly six.

TimerRunning.description: A persisted running deadline can already display zero; no per-second DB writes.
